data.name: Bishal
data.gender_notes: Bishal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Bishal is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vishal', which means 'extensive', 'spacious', or 'Lord Vishnu's abode'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is the preserver of the universe, and his abode is believed to be vast and spacious. This name is considered auspicious and bestows the blessings of Lord Vishnu upon the bearer.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that connects the bearer to Lord Vishnu, symbolizing protection, preservation, and divinity.
data.etymology: Bishal belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord Vishnu's abode.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bishal total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
